approved: Supported the Australian River Co. Limited Bill 2015 as an administrative measure to abolish the company and transfer its functions, assets and liabilities to the Commonwealth, while arguing that Australia should maintain a stronger Australian-flagged shipping presence for economic, environmental and national security reasons.

Reported that retaining a viable shipping industry was essential, but said the coastal trading licensing system had substantially increased freight rates, including a 63 per cent rise in one year for Bell Bay Aluminium.
